result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The wide roadway and absence of street trees or buffers create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Long Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island for protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the zebra markings.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signal heads (walk/don't walk) are present to guide crossing timing.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signal poles on the intersection corners.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and traffic signals in a residential setting. However, significant drainage issues and pavement degradation at the curb create physical barriers for pedestrians, and the infrastructure lacks modern accessibility features like tactile warning pads.

hazards.name: Standing water and drainage failure
hazards.description: A large puddle at the base of the curb ramp creates a slip hazard and forces pedestrians to deviate from the marked crossing path.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left corner of the intersection near the curb

hazards.name: Lack of tactile warning surfaces
hazards.description: The curb ramps do not have truncated domes, which are necessary for visually impaired pedestrians to identify the transition to the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible curb ramps at the intersection corners

interventions.title: Drainage and Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Regrade the gutter and repair the roadway surface to eliminate standing water at the pedestrian crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance, improve pedestrian visibility, and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: ADA Accessibility Upgrades
interventions.description: Retrofit existing curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces (truncated domes).

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for crossing a wide arterial road. However, the long, unprotected crossing distance across multiple travel lanes without a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a midway refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and lack of physical traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes extending into the background

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals, with sidewalks present on all sides. However, the crossing distance is relatively wide without a median refuge, and dedicated pedestrian signal heads are not clearly visible in the image.

hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, which can lead to uncertainty about when it is safe to cross at a signalized intersection.
